headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY YTD
summary: As of July 8, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming SPY with an average return of 16.24% compared to SPY's 10.00%. This results in an average alpha of 6.23%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered a remarkable return of 42.26%, contributing significantly to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 100', has returned 8.75%, still above the benchmark but less impactful. This outperformance is particularly relevant during periods of market stress, as it reflects the portfolio's resilience against broader market fluctuations. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
